zones.name: IPJ lid and maintenance bay — 6 × 6 m

traces.name: Fresh feed
traces.description: Hammer crusher → IPJ feed mix box → feed pump → IPJ. Fresh hammer product does not pass through the VSI first.

traces.name: VSI return loop
traces.description: IPJ tails → screen-feed sump / pump → 0.8 mm screen → +0.8 mm oversize conveyor CV02 → VSI → IPJ mix box. All VSI product returns upstream of the IPJ. No separate drain transfer is installed.

traces.name: Gold recovery
traces.description: IPJ concentrate → feed box → ONE Russell jig (nominal 2 × 2 ft). Jig, spiral and Falcon concentrates feed the shaking table; table concentrate goes to drying and smelting.

traces.name: Fines & tailings
traces.description: Screen −0.8 mm → three spirals → Falcon. Table tails → two Knudsen bowls → tailings. The two bowls are shown in series as an assumption requiring Nigel’s confirmation. TSF tie-in is a connection reservation, not a designed storage facility.

holds.title: Equipment and maintenance
holds.detail: Solid symbols occupy scheduled planning envelopes. The single Russell jig retains a provisional 2.5 × 1.5 m machine allowance; 2 × 2 ft is its nominal size, not an overall vendor dimension. Confirm all vendor general arrangements, nozzle locations, guards, foundations and component removal paths. The 6 × 6 m IPJ bay and 8 × 9 m VSI bay are access reservations, not validated lifting designs.

holds.title: Levels, pumps and pipe crossings
holds.detail: Plan routing alone does not prove gravity flow. Establish a hydraulic elevation profile for screen, spirals, jig and table; confirm flows, slurry density, settling velocities, pump curves and suction conditions. Some gravity routes may need revised levels or additional pumps. Crossing lines are not joined unless the endpoints identify a common header or collector. The final tailings line needs a protected crossing under the east lane.

holds.title: Conveyors and recirculating duty
holds.detail: Fresh hammer product goes to the IPJ mix box. Screen +0.8 mm oversize goes directly by belt conveyor CV02 to the VSI; all VSI product returns to the mix box. The screen target is 0.8 mm. Conveyor lengths are horizontal centrelines; belt width, slope, support positions and transfer heights await vendor design. There is no separate drain: confirm the VSI can accept the moisture content of wet-screen oversize.

holds.title: Site position and civil work
holds.detail: The yard is now 100 × 60 m (6,000 m², 400 m² more than P3). Its centre is unchanged, retaining the 70 m south move from P1. The reservation is inside the supplied source lease polygon with about 43.6 m minimum plan clearance. This is not a survey setback. Confirm current tenure, terrain, drainage, earthworks, external access and vehicle swept paths; the 6 m roads are planning reservations.

holds.title: Separate solar reservations
holds.detail: The widened yard overlaps 3,500 m² of the previous large plant-solar concept. That option still needs relocation before adopting both plans. The separate 100-panel camp option has approximately 48 m plan gap to this yard; this does not establish electrical separation requirements.

holds.title: Capacity, electrical duty and remaining assumptions
holds.detail: The earlier 200 kVA estimate is not a verified plant load. Check the IPJ1000 fresh-plus-recirculating duty, all vendor power and starting loads, and the available water balance. One Russell jig is confirmed by the user. Two Knudsen bowls are retained in series as a layout assumption awaiting final duty confirmation. Five feed-pump reservations are provisional.

layout_reasoning.title: Readable west-to-east process
layout_reasoning.detail: ROM and primary crushing stay west of the central service lane. Bin, hammer, IPJ, screen, spirals and Falcon progress east without stretching machine footprints.

layout_reasoning.title: Compact VSI loop
layout_reasoning.detail: The VSI stays immediately north of the mix box, with a straight return conveyor. A direct, labelled oversize conveyor connects the 0.8 mm screen to the VSI. The VSI service bay opens toward the north access lane.

layout_reasoning.title: One jig, close to the IPJ
layout_reasoning.detail: The Russell jig sits south of the IPJ with a short concentrate feed. Its tails route back to the screen sump; its concentrate joins the cleanup feed. The unnecessary second jig and all its branches are removed.

layout_reasoning.title: Separate people, loaders and maintenance
layout_reasoning.detail: The cleanup table and bowls run horizontally to the southeast, with a reserved operator aisle and dry-prep area below them. Tanks, electrical and stores stay to the southwest; keep final pedestrian access and lifting routes clear in detailed design.
